what_happened: Research confirmed all three dispatch-named edit sites for ITEM 1 (full-build phase-commit gate) and ITEM 2 (plan-section anchor-forward-from-heading rule) in the lean source store at current line numbers close to the dispatch's estimates. Also confirmed ITEM 2's failure mode has no existing generic home anywhere in the core extension (no section-splice/anchor pattern file exists), so the planner must choose between adding it narrowly to the 3 lean files (recommended: lowest friction, no scope widening needed) or creating a new core pattern file and widening file_scope.

Dispatch description's 'preserve the orthogonal constraint' paragraph mandates every lake build run via Bash(run_in_background: true); the current lean agent files PROHIBIT that tool parameter outright and mandate a foreground-first preference order with shell-level backgrounding as fallback (a landed revision). Plan treats the files' current text as authoritative and records the discrepancy as a Decision.

Dispatch and research both frame lean-implementation-flow.md as 'the shared flow both agents reference'. Grep shows neither agent file references it by path, and the lean index entry load_when.agents lists only lean-implementation-agent -- so the hard-mode agent never receives it as ambient context. Plan splits ITEM 2 treatment accordingly (pointer for the standard agent, inline self-contained text for the hard agent).

Discovered during planning that the long stale phrase 'acceptable for phase-end' matches ZERO lines because it wraps mid-phrase in the source, which would have made a naive post-edit grep sweep falsely report clean. Phase 4's sweep was written to use short single-line-safe fragments instead.

During Phase 1 drafting, ITEM 2's canonical anchoring block was briefly added to lean-implementation-flow.md's Stage 4A, then reverted before committing because that content is Phase 3's planned work (ITEM 2 in all three files), not Phase 1's (ITEM 1 in the flow file only). No functional impact; caught before the phase commit.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/lean/index-entries.json' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
